sources.snippet: NVIDIA Conformer-CTC Small is an English speech recognition model that can transcribe English speech into lowercase English letters containing spaces and apostrophes. This model is based on a non-autoregressive small variant of the Conformer architecture, with approximately 13 million parameters.
